properties.name: IO River

While we proudly power Cisco’s edge security, our vendor-agnostic architecture is designed to support and protect diverse, multi-vendor networking environments.

## About

Distributed Mitigation Managed Service (DMMS) is the technology of mitigating DDoS attacks using a network perimeter equipped with a chain of powerful fine-tuned firewalls. Our solution has four key advantages over the classic DDoS mitigation technique called “Clean Pipe” or “Cleaning Center”.

First is latency – traffic is mitigated directly on the network's perimeter avoiding the need to redirect

properties.name: IPTP DDoS Mitigation Solution
properties.description:
Distributed Mitigation Managed Service (DMMS) is the technology of mitigating DDoS attacks using a network perimeter equipped with a chain of powerful fine-tuned firewalls. Our solution has four key advantages over the classic DDoS mitigation technique called “Clean Pipe” or “Cleaning Center”.

First is latency – traffic is mitigated directly on the network's perimeter avoiding the need to redirect traffic to the “Cleaning Center”.

The next aspect is reaction time – fine-tuned firewalls automatically detect most types of floods and immediately start the mitigation process making reaction time close to none.

Another advantage of the IPTP DMMS service is the massive network capacity of over 35 Tb/s which allows the withstanding of heavy-bandwidth DDoS attacks without the risk of service degradation.

And last, but not least, are expenses. Mitigation with the classic “Cleaning Center/Clean Pipe” approach results in the concentration of high traffic volume on a single point, which usually requires purchasing extra bandwidth. The usage of a worldwide distributed network of an IPTP DMMS firewalls helps customers avoid these unexpected expenses by distributing traffic among multiple points in our network and eliminating the combined high load on a single node.

Tier-1 level service protection is FREE for our customers (common security for our network), i.e. Colocation, Dedicated hosting and IP transit clients. For additional costs, we can offer a dedicated equipment for Tier-2 direct managed protection against DDoS.

Dozens of DDoS Mitigation service providers use our DMMS network to deliver better security for their customers.

properties.name: APERION
properties.description:
APERION builds SmartFlow — the AI governance control plane for regulated enterprises. Think Zscaler for AI.

The problem is structural. 55% of enterprises have active agentic AI deployments. Only 4% are confident in their security posture. That 51-point gap is what SmartFlow closes.

Regulated enterprises face a fundamental contradiction: the AI tools their businesses need and the compliance obligations their regulators enforce cannot coexist in a cloud-dependent architecture. Data residency mandates, audit requirements, model explainability standards, and agentic AI risk are not solved by a SaaS layer sitting outside the enterprise perimeter.

SmartFlow resolves that contradiction. Deployed on-premises, Kubernetes-native, with zero tokens leaving the enterprise environment — it delivers a single control plane for every AI workload: identity-aware policy enforcement via AIDA, intelligent routing, semantic caching, cost management, and a full audit trail.

The result: 3.2x performance over direct model access, compliance documentation generated automatically for SR 11-7, FINRA 3110, FFIEC, and the EU AI Act, and no customer data retained by APERION. SmartFlow's semantic cache reduces token spend by up to 70%, making compliance self-funding from month one — full ROI in one to two quarters.

This isn't a proxy layer in front of OpenAI. It's the governance infrastructure for the AI era — built in Rust, running inside your perimeter, trusted by active paying customers and design partners in the S&P 200.

entity.name: IPTP DDoS Mitigation Solution
entity.description:
Distributed Mitigation Managed Service (DMMS) is the technology of mitigating DDoS attacks using a network perimeter equipped with a chain of powerful fine-tuned firewalls. Our solution has four key advantages over the classic DDoS mitigation technique called “Clean Pipe” or “Cleaning Center”.

First is latency – traffic is mitigated directly on the network's perimeter avoiding the need to redirect traffic to the “Cleaning Center”.

The next aspect is reaction time – fine-tuned firewalls automatically detect most types of floods and immediately start the mitigation process making reaction time close to none.

Another advantage of the IPTP DMMS service is the massive network capacity of over 35 Tb/s which allows the withstanding of heavy-bandwidth DDoS attacks without the risk of service degradation.

And last, but not least, are expenses. Mitigation with the classic “Cleaning Center/Clean Pipe” approach results in the concentration of high traffic volume on a single point, which usually requires purchasing extra bandwidth. The usage of a worldwide distributed network of an IPTP DMMS firewalls helps customers avoid these unexpected expenses by distributing traffic among multiple points in our network and eliminating the combined high load on a single node.

Tier-1 level service protection is FREE for our customers (common security for our network), i.e. Colocation, Dedicated hosting and IP transit clients. For additional costs, we can offer a dedicated equipment for Tier-2 direct managed protection against DDoS.

Dozens of DDoS Mitigation service providers use our DMMS network to deliver better security for their customers.

XIOS/3 supercharges SaaS for global performance and development agility. It leverages any existing code and increases the benefits of web open source technologies by facilitating edge computing (utilizing computing resources in the device edge), code reusability, faster time-to-market & improved user experience of web applications (edge acceleration), while lowering development & operational cost.

XIOS/3 is an Edge Application Platform that enables developers, ISVs, Enterprises and IT consultants to standardize their own code as well as open source components into reusable & maintainable building blocks that also becomes edge computing enabled. XIOS/3 uniquely allows web applications to utilize otherwise idle computing power in user devices, improving speed & usability, while reducing the cost of providing them, since the amount of requests to the cloud is reduced.

All in all, XIOS/3 is the technology to leverage existing web frameworks and refine open source by making it faster, better and cheaper to build applications in an era where everything is transitioning to the cloud and companies are striving for decentralization to the edge.

entity.name: APERION
entity.description:
APERION builds SmartFlow — the AI governance control plane for regulated enterprises. Think Zscaler for AI.

The problem is structural. 55% of enterprises have active agentic AI deployments. Only 4% are confident in their security posture. That 51-point gap is what SmartFlow closes.

Regulated enterprises face a fundamental contradiction: the AI tools their businesses need and the compliance obligations their regulators enforce cannot coexist in a cloud-dependent architecture. Data residency mandates, audit requirements, model explainability standards, and agentic AI risk are not solved by a SaaS layer sitting outside the enterprise perimeter.

SmartFlow resolves that contradiction. Deployed on-premises, Kubernetes-native, with zero tokens leaving the enterprise environment — it delivers a single control plane for every AI workload: identity-aware policy enforcement via AIDA, intelligent routing, semantic caching, cost management, and a full audit trail.

The result: 3.2x performance over direct model access, compliance documentation generated automatically for SR 11-7, FINRA 3110, FFIEC, and the EU AI Act, and no customer data retained by APERION. SmartFlow's semantic cache reduces token spend by up to 70%, making compliance self-funding from month one — full ROI in one to two quarters.

This isn't a proxy layer in front of OpenAI. It's the governance infrastructure for the AI era — built in Rust, running inside your perimeter, trusted by active paying customers and design partners in the S&P 200.

companies that resemble it. Resemblance has two halves, and they are judged
DIFFERENTLY:

                 requirement. Every lookalike must be the same kind of company
                 for the same kind of customer. No amount of feature overlap
                 substitutes for it.
  CAPABILITIES - what the seed does (e.g. payments, online ordering, payroll,
                 operations). A lookalike matches ANY non-empty subset. It does
                 not need all of them, and matching more is not required to
                 qualify - only to be a closer match.

So: a true lookalike clears the ANCHOR and shares at least one CAPABILITY.

You will be given:
